data.one_liner: A draggable Flutter widget like a bottom sheet panel for all platforms.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable SlidingBox widget that can be dragged up or down, scaled with min and max heights, and placed anywhere or as the root body in a Scaffold.
use_when: You want a bottom sheet or sliding panel interface that works across multiple platforms.
You need custom draggable drawer or box panels with animations and scroll control.
avoid_when: You only need standard modal bottom sheets provided out of the box by Material.
strengths: Supports all platforms (Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, Linux).
Highly customizable with controllers, backdrops, body builders, and custom styles.
weaknesses: Limited documentation for edge-cases beyond the provided examples.
